review_input.original_instruction: You're starting in a dining room, facing a china cabinet. Turn around behind you, and walk to the other side of the dining table, near the chair in the corner. You'll then turn left and exit the door on the right. You will walk into a living area. Go straight ahead, and walk toward the red couch farther from you. So, closer to the bay window. Walk to the- actually stand next to the brown side table next to that red couch. Don't pass the couch. Take a sharp left and you'll see an opening into, probably, a foyer. There is a brown credenza with a plant on it in that foyer. Just go ahead and jump over the coffee table next to that credenza. You'll see that a hallway goes off to the left. Go down that hallway. Just as a reference, there is slate floor- or tiling, and a framed picture in front of you. You'll then be taken into another living area that has stairs on the left. Go straight past the stairs, past the couch and go stand in front of the TV in the left corner of the room. You'll actually be standing right in front of the double doors, next to the TV. This is your final destination.
